svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Sage FSNY mark, v5
svg.desc: A sage FSNY lettermark inside the same single continuous tag silhouette. Equal right and bottom lobe motifs remove the stretched lower point while retaining the local association. The right and bottom lobe segments are exact reflections across x equals y, with equal six-unit-radius openings at reflected positions. Original, unadopted concept with editable lettering.
